image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is positioned centrally among wet, decaying brown autumn leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible with small dark eyes, and the body is robust. Forelimbs are visible, but hindlimbs are partially obscured by leaves and angle. The tail extends towards the right, partially hidden by foliage.
